name: Notion
description: Lets the agent read the Notion pages an issue or pull request links to, such as specifications, through Notion's hosted MCP server. Read and search tools only: the agent never edits Notion. It sees what the signed-in Notion account can see, so use a dedicated account or a narrowly shared workspace.

connections.name: notion-account
connections.label: Notion account for the agent
connections.help: Sign in to Notion with the account the agent should read as. The agent can open every page this account can open, so use a dedicated account that is shared only on the pages and teamspaces the agent needs.
